node.title: Re: Do you know any online IDE where user can choose some or any version of perl?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Note sure about online, but I use [https://perlbrew.pl/|perlbrew] to be able to quickly run a script on many different versions of Perl. On Windows, there's [stevieb]'s [id://1196244|berrybrew] ([https://github.com/stevieb9/berrybrew|on GitHub]). Update: There's also [http://www.dagolden.com/index.php/2390/setting-up-a-perl-development-environment-with-plenv/|plenv] (I think [https://github.com/tokuhirom/plenv|this] is the appropriate repo).
